summary: 60-foot crow's nest tree platform built about 1928 in the Kaniksu National Forest; abandoned in the 1940s; the tree and telephone wire remain, the platform appears gone.

facts.status_note: Platform appears gone; the tree and the telephone wire remain as of the 2022 accounts. Date of platform removal unknown.

visit.trail_note: Road ends about a quarter mile short of the tree. WillhiteWeb: park at the switchback at 2,680 feet on Gisborne Mountain Road and hike 0.6 miles one way along an abandoned spur road.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says nothing remains apart from the telephone wire and ladder stakes. WillhiteWeb says the tree still stands. Read together: the tree and wire are left, the platform is not.

notes_for_editor: The 1928 build and 1940s abandonment agree across all four pages; the 2022 site description comes from WillhiteWeb and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Not stated anywhere: builder, who staffed it, and whether the land is open to the public. Coordinate check: the brief's 48.32846, -116.86187 sits about 3 km from the Keeping Watch point 48.34789, -116.8328 (cdil.lib.uidaho.edu/keeping-watch/items/experimental-spur.html). Not resolved here; check before geotagging. Do not merge with the separate Experimental lookout page on idahofirelookouts (northern-idaho/experimental-lookout).
